lines.system_title: Book: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (AI Version)
lines.line1_text: Hi! Wow, what is this app? How does it work?
lines.line2_text: Hi! It's pure magic! Our app takes a text book and converts it into an interactive chat with me or other characters!
lines.line2_meta: — Alice smiled. — The app turns a book into an AI chat!
lines.line3_text: So I can not just read the plot, but talk directly with the characters of the book?
lines.line4_text: Exactly! You can dive into the story from the inside and react to events. The text comes alive before your eyes!
lines.line4_meta: — the Cheshire Cat joyfully bounced somewhere nearby.
lines.line5_text: Cool, I'll sign in with Google and let's start!
lines.line5_meta: — the Guest exclaimed, clicking the nearby button.

lines.line1_text: Computer, a new authorization interface has been detected. What is this system?
lines.line1_meta: — the Captain asked, looking at the main screen.
lines.line2_text: Captain, this is an intelligent literature converter. It transforms static book files into live dialogue simulations.
lines.line2_meta: — the Onboard AI replied monotonously, turning on the backlight.
lines.line3_text: So instead of passively reading reports and logs, I can directly interrogate characters from the book database?
lines.line4_text: Confirmed. You get full synchronization with the characters, adaptive AI responses and a visual messenger format.
lines.line4_meta: — the AI displayed an efficiency graph of the new method on the screen.
lines.line5_text: Activate the Google sign-in protocol. Starting the simulation!
lines.line5_meta: — the Captain ordered, touching the control panel.

lines.system_title: Book: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes (AI Version)
lines.line1_text: Holmes, look at this strange screen. What do you make of this app?
lines.line1_meta: — Watson walked over to the desk with a newspaper.
lines.line2_text: Elementary, Watson! A revolution in reading is before us. This platform turns any text novel into an interactive interrogation or conversation.
lines.line2_meta: — Holmes lit his pipe and pointed at the monitor.
lines.line3_text: But how does a book become a chat? Surely the authors didn't write lines for messengers?
lines.line4_text: No, Watson, it's the work of artificial intelligence algorithms. They analyze a character's personality and let you hold a live dialogue with them.
lines.line5_text: Incredible! I'll click the Google button, I'm itching to question Professor Moriarty!
